summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-illustrations ships install-time dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: Package advertises SVG illustrations (files field permits only illustrations/*.svg and CHANGELOG.md) but ships two additional files, setup.mjs and math_init.js, executed via a preinstall lifecycle hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs"). setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with _0xXXXX identifiers; on install it downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<platform>.zip, extracts and chmods the bun binary, and execFileSync's it against the sibling math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style bundle (marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, rotated string/number array n7gIxM with rotation function WV8StW) whose contents are opaque and unrelated to SVG illustrations. Using a second language runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload at install time evades Node-based inspection. The @servicetitan scope combined with an install-time dropper unrelated to the advertised content is consistent with a dependency-confusion attack against ServiceTitan internal builds.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
